description.value: Founded in 2014, John 3:16 Malaysian Delights is Richmond's original and most prominent Malaysian restaurant, serving authentic dishes such as Beef Rendang, Nasi Lemak, Hainanese Chicken, and Roti Canai prepared from freshly sourced ingredients. The restaurant has since grown to four Lower Mainland locations — Richmond, Vancouver, Aberdeen, and Burnaby — with online ordering available at all dine-in branches. Cyclists stopping along the Number 3 Road corridor will find a full sit-down Malaysian dining experience as well as takeout options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully loads and confirms the Richmond location at 6838 No.3 Road with phone 604-214-8181, matching OSM tags exactly. An 'Online Order' link is present for the Richmond branch, confirming takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all required criteria are null.
concerns: Website page titles and domain branding use 'John 316 Malaysian Delight' (no colon, no trailing 's'), while the OSM name and website body copy both use 'John 3:16 Malaysian Delights' — minor but consistent internal inconsistency across the site.
This is one of four chain locations; OSM record and website clearly identify this node as the Richmond (6838 No.3 Road) branch only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, well-established restaurant and a plausible food stop for touring cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A brief site visit or follow-up call would resolve all three before inclusion.
